card.name: Fixed phrases in press-release and REMS footers
card.fires_on: Words inside memorized footer text: the hyphen in the REMS phone number 800-503-0784, and the words after 'news releases' in the EurekAlert! disclaimer or 'News Provided by'.

modes.label: REMS phone number
modes.description: The hyphen inside the 800-503-0784 number in opioid REMS education text.

modes.label: News release disclaimer
modes.description: Words like 'to', 'posted' or '!' in the EurekAlert! disclaimer, or 'by' in 'News Provided by'.
modes.example: AAAS and EurekAlert! are not responsible for the accuracy of news releases posted<< to>> EurekAlert! by contributing institutions

card.writes: It suppresses words like released, publishes and 发布, so it steers away from release-wording and toward odd name-like pieces.
card.plain: It fires on stock footer lines, such as a REMS hotline number or a news-release disclaimer.
